name: Remotion Sequence-Local Kinetic Typography Presets
use_when: The agent needs reusable text animation components that can be placed anywhere in a Remotion timeline.
A title, caption-emphasis, or visual text preset should align to narration, beats, or sections.
Multiple typography presets need to be tested without global-frame coupling.
avoid_when: A one-off edit can be completed more safely with static text or simple NLE keyframes.
The text effect depends on footage tracking or masks that are not yet prepared.
The component would animate global timeline assumptions into a reusable preset.

timeline_pattern.pattern: parent_timeline_metadata -> Sequence(from, durationInFrames) -> local_frame_0 -> progress_or_spring -> transform/opacity/mask -> hold -> clear
timeline_pattern.local_frame_rule: Inside each preset, treat useCurrentFrame as local time for that Sequence.
timeline_pattern.placement_rule: The parent timeline decides from/duration based on beat frames, phrase starts, or visual emphasis points.
timeline_pattern.reuse_rule: Keep text, style, timing, safe region, and caption suppression as props or metadata.

motion.rule: Use interpolate for exact timed reveals and spring for physical entrances or overshoot.

keyframe_values.preset_duration: A 45-frame window at 30fps is a useful demo length; real edit duration should be based on word length and narration pace.
keyframe_values.word_delay: Use delayed local frames such as frame - index * delayFrames for staggered words.
keyframe_values.settle_hold: Reserve hold frames after the animated entrance so the viewer can read the final state.

sound.rule: Store optional SFX cue frames separately from the component so text timing can be adjusted without losing audio sync.

captions.rule: Store duplicateVisualText or captionSuppression flags when the component carries the spoken words.

color.rule: Keep color roles as props so the same motion can be tested on bright and dark footage without rewriting the component.

implementation.ffmpeg: Use the component output as a transparent ProRes/PNG overlay render when the effect is too complex for drawtext; composite later with overlay after alpha verification.
implementation.remotion: Wrap each text preset in Sequence, call useCurrentFrame inside the preset, calculate local progress from that frame rather than a global timeline frame, and export alpha overlays with PNG frames plus ProRes 4444 when the component is handed to another compositor.
implementation.blender: Use scene strips or action clips with local frame offsets for reusable text object animation.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Compound the text/effect group so wrapper timing can be moved without rebuilding internal keyframes.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Nest or subsequence reusable text graphics so they can be placed on different timeline beats.

common_mistakes: Hard-coding global start frames inside a reusable Remotion text component.
Animating text before assigning its safe region and caption policy.
Using spring motion for a reveal that must land on an exact mask frame.
Failing to hold the final readable state after the entrance.
qc: The same component starts correctly when placed at different Sequence from values.
The local first frame behaves as frame 0.
The final text state holds long enough to read.
Caption suppression metadata is set when designed text duplicates spoken words.
A phone-size render proves the component is readable in its actual placement.
If exported as a transparent overlay, the file has verified alpha and no opaque background.
